description: Unit tests for the DER parser in the net::der namespace, testing various parsing scenarios including TLV reading, optional tags, tag parsing, and error conditions.

methods.name: ParserTest.ConsumesAllBytesOfTLV
methods.description: Tests that the parser consumes all bytes of a TLV with an OCTET STRING tag.

methods.name: ParserTest.CanReadRawTLV
methods.description: Tests reading a raw TLV and verifying its length and data.

methods.name: ParserTest.IgnoresContentsOfInnerValues
methods.description: Tests parser behavior with nested sequences with invalid encoding.

methods.name: ParserTest.FailsIfLengthOverlapsAnotherTLV
methods.description: Tests parser failure when a sequence's length overlaps with another TLV.

methods.name: ParserTest.ReadOptionalTagPresent
methods.description: Verifies reading an optional tag that is present.

methods.name: ParserTest.ReadOptionalTag2Present
methods.description: Verifies reading an optional tag with optional value present.

methods.name: ParserTest.ReadOptionalTagNotPresent
methods.description: Verifies behavior when an optional tag is not present.

methods.name: ParserTest.ReadOptionalTag2NotPresent
methods.description: Verifies behavior when an optional tag is not present.

methods.name: ParserTest.CanSkipOptionalTagAtEndOfInput
methods.description: Tests skipping an optional tag at the end of input.

methods.name: ParserTest.SkipOptionalTagDoesntConsumePresentNonMatchingTLVs
methods.description: Ensures skipping optional tags does not consume non-matching TLVs.

methods.name: ParserTest.TagNumbersAboveThirtySupported
methods.description: Tests support for high tag numbers (above 30).

methods.name: ParserTest.ParseTags
methods.description: Verifies parsing of various tag types and classes.

methods.name: ParserTest.IncompleteEncodingTagOnly
methods.description: Tests parser behavior with incomplete tag encoding.

methods.name: ParserTest.IncompleteEncodingLengthTruncated
methods.description: Tests parser behavior with truncated long-form length.

methods.name: ParserTest.IncompleteEncodingValueShorterThanLength
methods.description: Tests parser behavior when value length is shorter than specified.

methods.name: ParserTest.LengthMustBeEncodedWithMinimumNumberOfOctets
methods.description: Verifies parser rejects length encodings with unnecessary leading zeros.

methods.name: ParserTest.LengthMustNotHaveLeadingZeroes
methods.description: Ensures parser rejects length encodings with leading zero bytes.

methods.name: ParserTest.ReadConstructedFailsForNonConstructedTags
methods.description: Tests that reading a constructed sequence fails if the tag isn't marked as constructed.

methods.name: ParserTest.CannotAdvanceAfterReadOptionalTag
methods.description: Verifies that parser cannot advance after reading an optional tag.

methods.name: ParserTest.ReadBitString
methods.description: Tests reading a valid BIT STRING.

methods.name: ParserTest.ReadBitStringBadTag
methods.description: Tests that reading a BIT STRING fails if the tag is incorrect.
